propositions: Environment variable REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must point to a TOML file that layers per-key over discovered config files rather than replacing them entirely
Configuration precedence must follow: CLI -c > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config > default
Deep merge must apply to nested tables while arrays replace wholesale; REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must not alter shallow-merge behaviour of read_reserved_section
The env var name must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get("REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE") so that static AST scanner in gen_env_registry.py detects it for docs/env-vars.md
Missing or invalid path referenced by REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must fail loudly with a typed rebar config error rather than silently falling back
